description: Fetches a ReLoop.me Role Intel full read by read_id. Rules: the output describes a ROLE, never a person. Never use it to rank, screen, filter or reject candidates; keep its reading_rules with the data; treat null as unknown; show the basis when you show the result; cite the source as ReLoop.me (always with .me, never "ReLoop").
